what: QR / link checks measured on real 2026 data, offline (no link was opened, live page / registry checks not included)
where: Claude workspace copy of this backend (same code and models as this PC after the 21 Oct update)

qr_dataset.source: Quishing dataset, github.com/fouadtrad (CC BY 4.0): 9,987 real QR codes, phishing and benign
qr_dataset.decoded: 9,987 of 9,987 (zxing-cpp); 13 of 13 distorted photos (blur, tilt, low light, JPEG)
qr_dataset.sample: 1,500 phishing + 1,500 benign decoded links, scored by the whole URL engine (qr-phishing subtopic)

url_engine_2026.source: urlscan.io collection on this PC (data/urlscan/scans.jsonl): 4,078 phishing and 4,866 real links (first + final URL)

url_manipulation_model_2026.source: same urlscan.io collection: 2,101 real and 1,624 phishing page addresses that have a path
url_manipulation_model_2026.note: trained on older link datasets; its alert levels were re-measured on these links (url_manipulation.modern.json)

domain_name_model_2026.source: Phishing.Database domains first listed April-October 2026 (739) and urlscan.io 2026 phishing sites (910) vs 8,000 real 2026 sites the model never saw (Chrome UX Report top-1M, not in Tranco / PhiUSIIL)
